name: Coca-Cola Consolidated - Columbus Distribution Center, OH

fieldNotes.facility: Coca-Cola Consolidated Columbus Distribution Center - a $90M, 60-acre campus in the Rickenbacker Industrial Center on Rohr Road, opened/unveiled May 2025 (groundbreaking Oct 2023). 400,000 sq ft distribution & warehouse building plus two 15,000 sq ft buildings for equipment repair and fleet maintenance; ~350 employees; 16M+ cases/year. Confirmed visually by the fleet of red Coca-Cola Consolidated / Red Classic tractors parked on site.
fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (39.845821,-82.956124, GEOMETRIC_CENTER on Rohr Rd) landed ~700m east of the campus on undeveloped land. Corrected to the campus center at 39.84250,-82.96250 via satellite identification (fleet shop buildings + red Coke tractors).
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard booth. Street View (2024-08) of the campus driveway off Rohr Rd shows an open entrance leading to the office and parking; no checkpoint structure.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the property line. Listed uncertain (campus interior not fully street-viewable).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True - distinct multi-building campus: one large 400K sq ft DC plus two separate 15K sq ft fleet/equipment buildings.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock-door row on the main building's east face (~40 doors, with trailers + red tractors) plus a secondary dock row on the west face (~20). Total estimated ~60; banded 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building - dock banks on two opposite faces (east and west), consistent with separate shipping/receiving flows.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive herringbone trailer drop yard along the east apron and around the fleet buildings; well over 50 trailers.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep open paved campus interior gives ample truck stacking room.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open campus entrance and large paved aprons; room for an express lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property (Rickenbacker has rail nearby but not into this campus).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Columbus OH metro, inside the Rickenbacker Industrial Center; classified Urban.

citations.claim: $90M Columbus facility, 400,000 sq ft DC + 350+ team, opened spring 2025

verification.rationale: Brand-new (2025) Coca-Cola Consolidated-owned distribution/warehouse/fleet campus at Rickenbacker; clearly a yard.
